summary: Iteration 131 - MoltBot Canvas Renderer Integration Testing: Successfully verified the new React Canvas Renderer as primary preview mode with iframe as secondary. Canvas mode renders elements, device switcher works, mode switching works without crash, properties panel integration intact, and no regressions in page selector/manifest/save flow.

issues: Canvas elements stack at same position (0,0) when no saved positions exist - all 6 elements overlap. This is expected behavior for a visual editor but could benefit from auto-layout for initial element positioning.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider adding auto-layout logic to spread elements vertically when they have no saved positions (UX enhancement, not blocking)

All toolbar buttons functional (Save, Preview, Reset, Undo, Redo)
Three-column layout preserved (360px sidebars, flexible preview column)
